card.name: Lead-in to a list of symptoms
card.fires_on: Small words right before a symptom list, such as a colon, "include", "and" or "experience", after phrases like "signs and symptoms may". The list usually starts with fever or sweats.

modes.label: Symptom list opener
modes.description: A colon or verb such as include or experience that introduces a list of signs and symptoms.
modes.example: Symptoms may<< include>> fever, dyspnea, hypox

modes.label: Inside a symptom list
modes.description: A linking word or partial word within a running list of symptoms such as chills or exhaustion.

card.writes: It pushes systemic symptom words like sweating and shaking, and pulls down abdominal terms.
card.plain: It fires just before a list of symptoms such as fever, chills or sweats, and not stomach symptoms.
